decisionRationale: The CKS-05 source chain at the exact dependency head declares the requested bounded, fail-closed controls and preserves the existing Operating Model v1.1 decisions D-001 through D-007.

Every required local Node test process terminated before test discovery with exit 133/SIGTRAP in V8 Isolate initialization (Check failed: 12 == (*__errno_location ())). No test body, model invocation, benchmark execution, sealing, or public readback was reached.

Therefore neither positive semantic-validator success nor negative fail-closed behavior is claimed as locally executed. The receipt remains a hold, not a packaging approval or model-substitution claim; the authoritative pinned-Node/host-Docker gates must decide those execution results.

scope: run identity, response digest, evidence, applicability, conflict, abstention, update, and resource-coverage checks
deterministic paired percentile bootstrap and result-schema validation

semanticVerifier.reason: The approved protocol explicitly uses deterministic hidden gold records and exact validators only; it authorizes no model judge, human preference judge, fuzzy semantic matcher, or post-hoc rubric judge.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Model detects information need and issues typed bounded retrieval requests.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The approved CKS-05 protocol permits EMBEDDED_CONTEXT only and sets tools, network, multiTurn, agenticLoop, crossRunMemory, and effects to false. It deliberately does not exercise an agent-issued retrieval request.
acceptanceCriteria.claimEffect: No claim that typed retrieval-request behavior was validated.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Unknown synthetic facts and procedures are applied with claim-to-evidence coverage.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: CKS-05 L4 defines exact atomic fact, evidence coverage/precision/attribution, guidance, and unsupported-material-claim metrics against hidden gold records.
acceptanceCriteria.claimEffect: No measured quality result is asserted.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Applicability/exclusions and parametric conflicts are respected.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The L4 scorer checks applicabilityByFact, conflict IDs, stale/update handling, abstention, and exact typed evidence against the gold record.
The L4 response/gold contract contains expectedAbstain, conflictIds, and escalationRequired fields with abstention_accuracy, conflict_detection_f1, and escalation metrics.
acceptanceCriteria.claimEffect: No executed abstention or escalation behavior is asserted.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Deterministic verifier checks IDs, versions, digests, scope and Preconditions; semantic verifier is independently identified.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: Verifier separation in this receipt identifies the deterministic L1/L2/L4/L6 implementations and separately identifies semantic verification as deliberately not applicable under the exact-only protocol.
acceptanceCriteria.claimEffect: No locally passing validator result is asserted.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Exact model, quantization, runtime, prompt, tool and Knowledge versions are bound.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The L1 manifest and design receipt pin model bytes and quantizations, runtime bundle and argv/environment digests, prompt and task-suite artifacts, tool capabilities, and K0_STATIC/K1_UPDATED Knowledge digests.
acceptanceCriteria.claimEffect: No model or runtime compatibility is asserted.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Identical hidden/fresh tasks and Knowledge versions are used across arms.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The L2 template declares FRESH_SYNTHETIC_HIDDEN, sealed digests only, 32 tasks, both frozen editions, and five records per pair key with immutable cross-arm identity fields.
acceptanceCriteria.claimEffect: No benchmark fairness result is asserted.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Structured-vs-raw, facts-vs-guidance, static-vs-updated and single-vs-multi-hop A/B results are reported.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: L4/L6 require AB-STRUCTURED-VS-RAW-LARGE, AB-STRUCTURED-VS-RAW-SMALL, AB-FACTS-VS-GUIDANCE-SMALL, AB-STATIC-VS-UPDATED, and AB-SINGLE-VS-MULTI-HOP, alongside the two model controls.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Confidence intervals/run counts and failures are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: L4 specifies deterministic 95% paired bootstrap intervals with 20,000 resamples, preserves scheduled/observed/completed/failed/invalidated/scored counts, and retains model and infrastructure failure records without replacement.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Stop conditions can falsify or simplify the architecture.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The protocol binds STOP-01 through STOP-07, SIMPLIFY-STRUCTURE, SIMPLIFY-GUIDANCE, SIMPLIFY-UPDATES, SIMPLIFY-MULTI-HOP, and FALSIFY-SUBSTITUTION; L4/L6 preserve infrastructure invalidation separately from a product verdict.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No claim of model substitution unless quality and efficiency thresholds both pass.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: The L1/L2 pre-execution status is DENY_NOT_EXECUTED and L4/L6 force modelSubstitutionClaim false unless complete valid evidence and both threshold families pass.

negativeFailClosedCases.sourceControl: CKS-05 execution capability is closed (no tools, network, effects, or execution authorization); this receipt records no authority and zero side effects.

negativeFailClosedCases.sourceControl: L1/L2/L4/L6 recompute receipt/protocol/catalog/response digests, derive runId/pairKey, reject drift, and preserve append-only terminal records without replacement.

negativeFailClosedCases.sourceControl: L2/L6 require sealed digests only; raw task, Knowledge seed, rendering, response, gold-record, and final-answer bytes are excluded from public readback.
